text: Grupo Visabeira consolidates its accounts in the entity NCFGest, SA, its majority shareholder, which is held 100% by Fernando Campos Nunes; the notes also state the ultimate majority shareholder held 98.57% of Grupo Visabeira indirectly at the end of 2024 and 2025.
short: Fernando Campos Nunes holds 98.57% of Grupo Visabeira via NCFGest.

source.name: Grupo Visabeira, Relatório & Contas 2025 (p. 89)
source.quote: O Grupo Visabeira consolida as suas contas na entidade NCFGest, SA, acionista maioritária e detida a 100% por Fernando Campos Nunes.
